sentences.ar: بيوم، بيكي فتحت كتاب الأستاذ بالسر.
sentences.en: One day, Becky secretly opened the teacher’s book.

sentences.ar: توم فاجأها، وهي خافت وقطعت صفحة.
sentences.en: Tom startled her, and she was frightened and tore a page.

sentences.ar: بعد شوي، الأستاذ سأل: مين قطع الكتاب؟
sentences.en: A little later, the teacher asked: who tore the book?
He began asking one by one.
When he reached Becky, Tom stood up.
He said: I am the one who did it.
He took the beating while looking at her.
